messages:
maya_sales: Need quick greenlight: One-time concession for PulseMed. They want Dedicated + Private deploy, 12mo. Asking 28% off list and waive onboarding SOW fee. Procurement timeline long; theyre a regional hospital group.

leo_dealdesk: Can you share ARR/TCV and upsell rationale? Any precedent for similar public sector discounts?

maya_sales: Proposed TCV = $410k (list $570k). Upsell: device integrations and statewide rollouts, potential $1.1M in year 2. They require HIPAA, entitlements, and a privacy addendum.

joel_revops: Numbers check:
```
List: $570,000
Proposed: $410,400
Discount: 28%
Est. contribution margin: ~20%
```
If we waive SOW fee, need offset: service credits or strict milestone.

tara_finance: Finance provisional OK if: (1) signed PO before provisioning, (2) 10% non-refundable initial invoice, (3) Net45 payment terms, and (4) a 12mo expansion clawback clause. Also require no stacking with other promos.

maya_sales: Customer insists on Net60 and zero upfront. Procurement says Net45 not possible due to fiscal calendar.

leo_dealdesk: Counterproposal: accept Net60 only with (a) PO + letter of budget intent, (b) 10% non-refundable invoice, and (c) convert SOW fee to a $30k credit applied over first 4 invoices instead of full waiver. Also add expansion milestone at month 12 with partial rebate if unmet.

nina_legal: I'll draft an amendment: pricing table, payment milestones, credit application, expansion/clawback language, and a data-handling addendum. Need final SOW line items to attach.

billing-bot: Draft invoice template created: /invoices/templates/pulsemed_specialpricing_v1.docx

tara_finance: Marking provisional approval pending PO + signed amendment. If procurement can't produce PO in 30 days, deal needs re-review.

maya_sales: I'll push for PO and the budget letter. Sharing SOW items with @nina_legal now. Thanks everyone. :pray:

leo_dealdesk: Provisional approved. Escalate to VP Sales if procurement refuses PO or wants full fee waiver. :thumbsup:
